annotation.title_clean: Final Report: Toward Harmonized AI Policies and Recommendations for the Caribbean
annotation.title_en: Final Report: Toward Harmonized AI Policies and Recommendations for the Caribbean
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Caribbean AI Task Force (CAITF), Caribbean Telecommunications Union
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Final report of the CTU Caribbean AI Task Force diagnosing representation, coordination, implementation and research gaps in Caribbean AI governance and setting out seven pillar-based recommendations for harmonized regional AI policy anchored in the UNESCO Recommendation. Focuses on data, infrastructure, talent, public sector, climate resilience and regional leadership; no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: CARICOM lacks any collective AI governance instrument; no member state has an adopted national AI strategy.
Develop a regional AI governance framework anchored in the UNESCO Recommendation, with minimum standards for transparency, risk classification and procurement.
Harmonize data-protection and cross-border data-flow frameworks across CARICOM.
Assess AI systems for disparate performance across Caribbean languages and dialects before public-sector deployment.
Establish a coordinated CARICOM voice in UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance and pursue interoperability.
